dedupe_keys.name: postes electriques rte sur la france metropolitaine

description: Postes électriques RTE sur la France métropolitaine is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The RTE substations are represented by a point which corresponds to the geographical barycentre of the high and very high voltage transformer electrical installations and by a surface which corresponds to the perimeter of the installations. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "RTE substations in mainland France" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
